title: Characterization of a polysaccharide from Rhodobryum giganteum and its activation effects on TLR4/PI3K-Akt/IkappaBalpha pathway.
authors: Geng, Jia-Mei; Zhu, Pei-Feng; Xu, Lu-Shuang; Liu, Ji-Lai; Yang, Zheng-Qing; Yang, Zhu-Ya; Jin, Qiong; Liu, Lu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苔藓多糖RGP的免疫调节活性及其与TLR4/PI3K-Akt/IkappaBalpha通路的结合，虽含分子对接与动力学模拟，但对象为多糖-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The medicinal moss Rhodobryum giganteum is rich in polysaccharides, whose structural and biofunctional properties remain largely unexplored. In this study, a novel glucose-rich polysaccharide fraction (named RGP, 29.8 kDa) was isolated and characterized from R. giganteum. Structural analysis revealed a unique alpha-1,6-linked glucan backbone with C-2 acetylation, along with side chains composed of -->4)-alpha-d-glucopyranosyl-(1 --> and terminal alpha-d-glucopyranose units. RGP significantly promoted proliferation, phagocytosis, and cytokine (TNF-alpha, IL-6) secretion via the TLR4/PI3K-Akt/IkappaBalpha pathway in RAW264.7 cells. In immunosuppressed mice, RGP restored immune function, as shown by improved organ indices, elevated serum immunoglobulins (IgA, IgG, IgM), and alleviated splenic damage. Molecular docking revealed that RGP binds the hydrophobic pocket of the TLR4/PI3K-Akt/IkappaBalpha complex via its glucose chain, and dynamics simulations confirmed the stability of this interaction. These findings reveal the bioactivity of bryophyte polysaccharides and suggest RGP as a potential immunomodulatory agent.
abstract_zh: 药用苔藓植物暖地大叶藓（Rhodobryum giganteum）富含多糖，其结构和生物功能特性在很大程度上尚未被探索。本研究从暖地大叶藓中分离并表征了一种新型富含葡萄糖的多糖组分（命名为RGP，29.8 kDa）。结构分析揭示其具有独特的α-1,6-连接葡聚糖主链，并伴有C-2乙酰化，侧链由→4)-α-d-吡喃葡萄糖基-(1→和末端α-d-吡喃葡萄糖单元组成。RGP通过TLR4/PI3K-Akt/IkappaBalpha通路显著促进RAW264.7细胞的增殖、吞噬作用及细胞因子（TNF-α、IL-6）分泌。在免疫抑制小鼠中，RGP恢复了免疫功能，表现为器官指数改善、血清免疫球蛋白（IgA、IgG、IgM）升高以及脾脏损伤减轻。分子对接显示，RGP通过其葡萄糖链结合TLR4/PI3K-Akt/IkappaBalpha复合物的疏水口袋，动力学模拟证实了该相互作用的稳定性。这些发现揭示了苔藓植物多糖的生物活性，并表明RGP是一种潜在的免疫调节剂。
